    tsdst.feature_selection.forwardSelection¶

    tsdst.feature_selection.forwardSelection(XY, target_var, model, metric='bic', family='gaussian', verbose=True, n_jobs=1, early_stop=False, perc_min=0.01, stop_at_p=1000, stop_when=5, use_probabilities=False, return_type='all', serialize_flavor='feather', use_threads=True)[source]¶

    Select predictors greedily by an information criterion.

    Each step fits every remaining candidate with the previously selected predictors and chooses the lowest criterion. The first step selects the best single predictor. Later steps stop when the criterion does not improve. This is a greedy search; an exhaustive search would consider the powerset of predictors and has exponential cost.

    Parameters:
    XYpandas.DataFrame

    Combined predictors and response, with named columns.

    target_varstr

    Response column.

    modelestimator

    An unfitted estimator with fit and predict, plus predict_proba for a binomial family. Candidate fits and the returned fit use separate clones.

    metric{‘aic’, ‘aicc’, ‘bic’, ‘ebic’}, optional

    Information criterion; lower is better. The default is ‘bic’.

    family{‘gaussian’, ‘binomial’, ‘poisson’}, optional

    Likelihood family. The default is ‘gaussian’.

    verbosebool, optional

    Print selected predictors and progress. The default is True.

    n_jobsint, optional

    Positive worker count. One runs serially. The default is 1.

    early_stopbool, optional

    Also apply stop_at_p and consecutive-small-improvement stopping. The default is False.

    perc_minfloat, optional

    Minimum relative criterion improvement before a step counts as small. Improvement is (previous-current)/max(abs(previous), 1). Used with early_stop=True. The default is 0.01.

    stop_at_pint, optional

    Maximum selected feature count with early stopping. The default is 1000.

    stop_whenint, optional

    Consecutive small improvements allowed with early stopping. The default is 5.

    use_probabilitiesbool, optional

    For binomial selection, compress the previous selected model to its second-class probability column when at least two predictors have already been selected. The final returned model is fitted to the selected original predictors. The default is False.

    return_type{‘list’, ‘model’, ‘data’, ‘all’}, optional

    Return selected names, the fitted model, selected predictor data, or all three as a tuple. The default is ‘all’.

    serialize_flavor{‘feather’, ‘parquet’}, optional

    Temporary worker table format. PyArrow is required for parallel work. The default is ‘feather’.

    use_threadsbool, optional

    Use threads when True or processes when False. Process callables and estimators must be pickleable. The default is True.

    Returns:
    resultlist, estimator, pandas.DataFrame, or tuple

    Objects selected by return_type. The input estimator and dataframe are not mutated. A tie in criterion improvement stops the search.

    Notes

    Information criteria use unpenalized likelihoods and include an estimated intercept and Gaussian noise variance in the parameter count. AICc is undefined when n <= k+1 and then returns infinity. Relative stopping is an optional computational choice and does not replace the information criterion. Temporary worker tables are removed in the search cleanup path.
